name: iam:UpdateLoginProfile
description: Anyone with iam:UpdateLoginProfile can change the password of any user they have this permission on. This is often abused to gain access to another principal's account and their associated permissions via the AWS Console.
author: Seth Art

required.description: Target IAM user must be in Resource section

admin: Target user must already have a login profile (password)
Target user must have administrative permissions (e.g., AdministratorAccess)
lateral: Target user must already have a login profile (password)

references.title: AWS Privilege Escalation Methods and Mitigation

options.name: TARGET_USER
options.description: Target IAM user name to update login profile for

options.name: PASSWORD
options.description: New password for the login profile (auto-generated if not provided)

options.name: NO_PASSWORD_RESET
options.description: Skip password reset requirement on first login (true/false)
